name: Freya Charmara
source: Freya Charmara, princess of Planet Charmara. Otherwise known as the Outlier Princess. She's led a tough life despite her position. Years and years of ridicule from her people has backed her into a corner. That all changed one fateful day, when she met up with the leader of the Misfits.
translation: Freya Charmara, princess of Planet Charmara. Otherwise known as the Outlier Princess. She's led a tough life despite her position.
